When was Lee Child Born? How old is Lee Child?

Lee Child was born on October 29th, 1954. Lee Child is currently 72 years old.

Where was Lee Child Born?

Lee Child was born in Coventry, England and is English.

What awards has Lee Child won?

Lee Child has won the following awards: Diamond Dagger Award at the Crime Writers' Association Award (2013), Thrillermaster at the International Thriller Writers Award (2017), Outstanding Contribution to Crime Fiction at Theakston's Old Peculier (2017), Author of the Year at the British Book Awards (2019) and the Grand Master at the Edgar Award (2026).

What book awards has Lee Child won?

Killing Floor: Anthony Award: Best First Mystery (1998), Barry Award: Best First Novel (1998), Nielsen Awards: Platinum Bestseller (2018).
The Enemy: Nero Award: Best Mystery Novel (2005), BookBrowse Awards: Ruby Award (2005), Barry Award: Best Novel (2005).
61 Hours: Theakston's Old Peculier: Crime Novel of the Year (2011).
The Affair: CrimeFest: Sounds of Crime Award (2012).
A Wanted Man: British Book Awards: Crime and Thriller Book of the Year (2012).
Running Blind / The Visitor: Nielsen Awards: Gold Bestseller (2017).
Never Go Back: The Dead Good Reader Award: The Page to Screen Award for Best Adapted Book (2017).
Personal: Nielsen Awards: Gold Bestseller (2017).
Make Me: Nielsen Awards: Gold Bestseller (2017).
Night School: Nielsen Awards: Silver Bestseller (2018).
Blue Moon: CrimeFest: Sounds of Crime Award (2020).
How to Write a Mystery: A Handbook from Mystery Writers of America: Agatha Award: Best Non-fiction (2021), Anthony Award: Best Non-Fiction Book (2022).

What was the first book Lee Child wrote?

The first book written by Lee Child was Killing Floor, published in 1997.

What was the most recent book Lee Child wrote?

His most recently released work was Chain Reaction on October 20th, 2026.

  2. Die Trying (8.25)

What genres does Lee Child Write?

Lee Child primarily writes in the Crime Fiction, Mystery, and Thriller genres. His work includes sub-genres such as Crime Thriller, Action Thriller, and Small-Town Mystery.

Are there upcoming new books by Lee Child?

Lee Child has written 84 books, with 1 more upcoming, across 24 series and categories, excluding contributions to anthologies.

What books are the Reacher TV series based on?

The first season of Reacher is based on the first book in the series, Killing Floor. The second season of Reacher is based on Bad Luck and Trouble, the 11th novel in the Jack Reacher series.

Does Lee Child still write the Jack Reacher books?

In interviews following the release of The Secret, Lee and Andrew stated that it was a four book deal with the two of them co-authoring together, and that following that, all future books would be written purely by Andrew.In an interview with Crimereads, it was confirmed that Andrew has solely written the books beginning with In Too Deep, although Lee still appears on the byline.
